name: nowcast_input
reviewed: wave-1 adversarial review (deepseek-v4-flash); findings manually verified before adoption (never-blend docstring confirmed interface.py:10-16; KSNDMC capture-time anchoring confirmed ksndmc.py:250+)
path: contract for src/jaladhar/forcing/nowcast.py (WF-3); config section configs/forcing.yaml: nowcast_input:
producer: WF-3 ImdNowcastAdapter (reading-1 route) or any future adapter behind this contract

abc_compliance.mode: ForcingMode.NOWCAST (no enum extension - THREE MODES NEVER BLENDED, interface.py docstring verified)
abc_compliance.get_forcing: def get_forcing(self, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime) -> RainfallEvent
abc_compliance.native_cell_ids: instance attribute REQUIRED (consumer event_replay.py:303 reads it outside the ABC); set in __init__ like imerg.py; for the uniform-fill district product this is a SINGLE district native cell (id 0, distinct_native_cells=1) so the consumer rate loop reads the uniform band value

cadence.interval_alignment_pinned: intervals start on WALL-CLOCK UTC boundaries aligned to interval_minutes (00:00,00:05,...) NOT on poll time - KSNDMC's capture-time anchoring precedent explicitly rejected because variable interval_minutes corrupts the consumer rate conversion
cadence.consumer_hardcode_resolution_binding: event_replay.py:314 hardcodes 30-min factor 2.0; WF-3 MUST parameterise it to interval_minutes (rate = depth_mm * (60/interval_minutes) / 3600 / 1000) as a PRECONDITION before any non-30 cadence ships; if unfixed, interval_minutes is const 30
cadence.vupto_truncation_boundary: when valid_until falls mid-interval, last interval end == min(valid_until, next wall-clock interval boundary) and truncated_at_valid_until:true - never extend backfill or fabricate past validity

interval_payload.rainfall_grid_mm: INCREMENTAL mm per interval on canonical grid EXPLICITLY 3421x3515 @ 10 m EPSG:32643 (cell_resolution_m=10.0) - cumulative sources convert inside adapter (interface.py:6-8 incremental semantics); RainfallInterval.__post_init__ invariants inherited
interval_payload.application_geometry_pinned: district polygon -> grid is UNIFORM FILL: every canonical cell inside the district MultiPolygon clipped to DEM bbox gets the band nominal mm/hr; outside cells 0.0; WFS GeoJSON is EPSG:4326 -> reproject to EPSG:32643 BEFORE clipping

timezone_rules.blanket_rule: ALL timestamps AWARE UTC - interval timestamps, provenance keys, poll_log.jsonl entries, logs; naive = CONTRACT VIOLATION
timezone_rules.source_formats_named: IMD toi/vupto are naive IST HHMM strings ('1900'=19:00 IST) -> convert via ZoneInfo('Asia/Kolkata') to aware UTC (1900 IST = 13:30 UTC); IMD update_time IS aware-UTC ISO and recorded VERBATIM as separate provenance key distinct from converted toi/vupto
timezone_rules.hazard_inheritance_blocked: open_meteo.py:158 labels naive IST as UTC today; this contract forbids repeating it

provenance_metadata_keys_required: imd_category_code enum over VERIFIED IMD cat1-cat19 schema; cat2->light, cat7->moderate, cat12->heavy mapped; ANY other code fails closed rather than guessed - exact WFS JSON key names confirmed during WF-3

intensity_mapping STRUCTURED object {light:{nominal_mm_hr:2.5,lower:0,upper:5,is_lower_bound:false}, moderate:{nominal_mm_hr:10.0,lower:5,upper:15,is_lower_bound:false}, heavy:{nominal_mm_hr:15.0,lower:15,upper:null,is_lower_bound:true}, basis:'DECLARED ASSUMPTION - categorical bands not measured intensities'} - machine-readable for sensitivity sweeps
heavy band is UNBOUNDED ABOVE: nominal_mm_hr 15.0 is a STATED LOWER BOUND (is_lower_bound:true) - never presented as the intensity; sensitivity sweeps must treat heavy-band mass as a floor

fail_closed.exceptions: NowcastUnavailableError(ValueError) base TO BE DEFINED in interface.py BY WF-3 (grep-verified absent from repo 2026-08-24 - this contract mandates its creation, it does not claim it exists), with subclasses NowcastFetchError / NowcastStaleError / NowcastDistrictAbsentError so consumers distinguish retryable vs permanent
trigger_conditions: payload stale: now > valid_until + one validity window
fail_closed.forbidden_substitutions_absolute: NO blending of any kind labelled or not (interface.py:10-16 structural prohibition); climatology and last-observed persistence forbidden; NWP/Open-Meteo may be a SEPARATE separately-labelled source in a DIFFERENT RUN never blended into the nowcast event; zero-interval events structurally impossible (RainfallEvent invariant)
fail_closed.vupto_mid_window_rule: requested window extending past valid_until => TRUNCATE event at valid_until (last interval end == valid_until) + truncated_at_valid_until:true; never extend backfill or fabricate past validity

resolution_caveat_declared_open_axis: categorical district/station bands are NOT a high-resolution gridded field; sub-district structure only from separately-labelled sources in separate runs; carried in OPEN-ITEMS N-3, never hidden by uniform fill
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes: every produced RainfallEvent.metadata carries provenance keys above verbatim
poll log runs/forcing_nowcast/poll_log.jsonl fields fetch_time/http_status/issue_time/valid_until/freshness_seconds ALL aware UTC

RATE LIMIT + CACHE: adapter rate-limits WFS polls (respecting server courtesy intervals) and caches responses to disk so repeated runs/replays never re-fetch within one validity window; licence formalisation is OWNER ACTION, non-blocking for engineering
verify_mass_conservation() called inside get_forcing before return (interface.py:166 chain verification)
adapter asserts district_name=='BANGLORE URBAN' and freshness <= one validity window before returning
consumer_assertions_at_load: event_replay rate conversion parameterised (no 30-min hardcode) precondition met - enforced via NAMED function assert_rate_conversion_parameterised(event) that reddens if a non-30 interval_minutes reaches the hardcoded factor-2.0 path

assert_nowcast_metadata_contract(event): NAMED function WF-3 must implement and call (in event_replay.py or new module) asserting product_id + valid_until present and valid_until >= last interval end - without a named enforcement point V8 checks are decorative
uniform grid shape across intervals; grid identity 3421x3515@10m EPSG:32643 asserted
mass conservation passes (adapter-side AND consumer-side today)
